en-GB.name: Hush: Don't Wake the Mimic
en-GB.subtitle: Open slowly. Steal the gold.
en-GB.description:
Your iPhone Duo is a treasure chest. The chest is a sleeping mimic.

Stand your Duo like a little laptop: the raised half is the lid. Open it slowly and the candlelight spills in, showing the gold. Drag the loot into your bag gently, then ease the lid shut to keep it. Too fast, and the lid creaks, the mimic wakes, and it bites.

The game where you have to be gentle.

No ads. No in-app purchases. No accounts. No data collected. Pay once and it's yours.

SLOW HANDS WIN
- Open the lid slowly: the light reaches deeper into the chest as it opens
- Coins sit near the front, gems further back, and relics deep inside: open wide for those
- Drag gently: a fast drag rattles, and loot dropped outside the bag clunks
- Ease the lid shut with loot in your bag to bank it. Close it too quickly and the mimic can bite on the way down
- A bite costs everything in your bag and 15 seconds of torch

WATCH THE MIMIC
Every chest starts asleep. The noise meter on the chest floor fills when you move too fast and drains when you keep still. Snoring is good. When the snoring stops and the velvet tongue twitches, it's stirring. When the meter turns red and FREEZE appears, hold still and let it settle. Every mimic wears a name tag, and each has a habit: Snorers, Light Sleepers, Heavy Sleepers, and Dreamers who twitch in their sleep.

PUSH YOUR LUCK
Your torch burns down while you loot, and torch oil found in a chest buys more time. The chests get richer as you go, from Wooden to Iron-bound, Gilded and Royal, and so does the gold they pay. The ruby is deeper in: open wider, or bank what you have? When the torch goes out the run ends, and anything still in your bag is lost.

DAILY DUNGEON
The same chests for everyone, every day, and one try that counts. Then practise as much as you like.

RELICS AND THIEF RANKS
Twenty-four named relics hide deep in the better chests. Find each one once and it stays in your Relic Codex. Every coin you bank counts towards your thief rank: twelve ranks, from Pickpocket to Mimic Whisperer.

FIRST CHEST
Your first chest is a short lesson with a very heavy sleeper: open, grab, freeze, bank. Replay it from Settings any time.

MADE FOR THE FOLD. PLAYS ON EVERY iPhone.
On iPhone Duo the hinge is the lid, and how gently you move it is the whole skill: about two slow strokes per chest. You never lay the phone flat, close it or move it fast. Moving fast is how you lose. iPhone Duo softens one half of its screen for a moment when a fold starts, so Hush keeps the loot, the noise meter and every warning on the half that stays sharp, and shows you which half to lift. On any other iPhone, slide the lid open and shut with the lid slider. Same chests, same mimic, same leaderboards, but on the Duo you feel the lid creak under your fingers.

SOUND AND FEEL
The creak follows your exact speed, in sound and in haptics. The snores, the heartbeat, the coin clinks, the heavy thunk of a banked haul and the CHOMP are all synthesised live in the app. Every warning is shown on screen too, so you can play with the sound off. Sound plays with the silent switch on; a setting makes Hush respect it instead. Sound and haptics each have a switch, and there's a Reduce Motion setting.

GAME CENTER
Leaderboards for your Best Haul and the Daily Dungeon, and 12 achievements. It's optional: Hush works fully without signing in.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No accounts, no tracking, no data collected. Your progress stays on your iPhone.
en-GB.promotionalText: Stand your iPhone Duo like a little laptop and lift the lid, slowly. Grab the gold, ease it shut, don't wake the mimic. Lid slider on other iPhones. No ads, no IAP.

review.notes:
Thanks for reviewing Hush: Don't Wake the Mimic: a paid game with no ads, no in-app purchases, no accounts, no data collection and no network requests of its own.

1. TESTING WITHOUT AN iPHONE DUO (start here)
No Duo needed. Everything works on any iPhone and in the Simulator, upright (portrait).
- The screen is a treasure chest: the top half is the lid, the bottom half is the chest floor with the loot.
- First launch opens First Chest, a short lesson (no score, a heavy sleeper), one sentence per step. Skip appears after step 2; Settings > Replay First Chest plays it again.
- Open the lid with the LID SLIDER, the brass lever on the top half: drag it up slowly to open, down to shut.
- Drag a lit coin or gem down into the bag (the leather strip at the bottom edge).
- Slide the lid back down and hold it shut a moment: the bag is banked (scored) and the next chest arrives.
- The noise meter above the bag fills when you slide or drag fast and drains when you keep still. "FREEZE" means hold still. If it fills, the mimic bites: the bag is lost and the torch loses 15 seconds.
- The run ends when the torch burns out.

2. HOW THE HINGE IS USED (iPhone Duo)
Hush reads the hinge angle only through the public iOS 27.1 API (SwiftUI onHingeChange), behind an availability check. No private API. The angle is used only while the game is on screen; it is never stored or sent.
a) Stand the Duo like a small laptop (tabletop). The raised half is the chest lid; a card shows which half to raise.
b) The lid is shut at about 100 degrees and fully open at about 165. Ease back to about 110 or less and hold to bank.
c) The skill is moving the hinge SLOWLY: the game measures hinge speed, and fast movement makes noise.
d) When a fold starts, iOS briefly blurs one half of the inner screen, so by default Hush draws the chest turned round: the blurring half is the raised lid, and the loot, meters and warnings stay on the sharp half. Settings > Turn the chest round switches this off.
e) Below about 85 degrees play pauses ("Lift the lid a little") until reopened. Closed, the outer display shows a sleeping-mimic card. Above about 172 degrees a hint says "That's wide enough" (no penalty). Held like a book, a card asks to stand it up like a little laptop.

3. KIND TO THE DEVICE (Guidelines 2.4.2 and 1.4.5)
- Moving the hinge fast is the losing move and is never rewarded. About two slow strokes per chest, in the middle of the hinge's range.
- Hush never asks the user to close the phone, lay it flat or move the hinge quickly. Opening past 165 degrees gains nothing.
- No score, achievement or bonus rewards hinge speed or the number of moves.
- Play reads the angle, never the closed state. Nothing is placed on the screens.

4. MODES (nothing hidden, nothing to buy)
Run (chests until the torch burns out: Wooden, Iron-bound, Gilded, Royal); Daily Dungeon (the same chests for everyone that day, one scored try, then practice); First Chest. Relic Codex: 24 relics. Thief rank: 12 ranks by lifetime gold.

5. CONTENT (rated 9+)
A cartoon treasure-chest monster with one big eye. If the player is noisy it "bites": its teeth snap shut across the fold with a comic CHOMP and a red flash. Nobody is shown hurt; the player loses the loot in the bag and some torch time.

6. PRIVACY
No third-party SDKs, analytics, ads, accounts or tracking. Progress stays on the device. App Privacy: Data Not Collected.

7. GAME CENTER
Optional. 2 leaderboards (Best Haul, Daily Dungeon), 12 achievements (525 points), none hidden.

8. OTHER
- No notifications. Debug and demo modes are disabled in Release builds.
- Sound plays with the silent switch on; Settings > Respect silent switch turns that off. All sound is synthesized in the app; every sound cue also has an on-screen cue.
- Settings > Reduce motion turns off the screen shake and the red flash.

nomination.name: Hush - App Launch - iPhone Duo hinge-speed stealth
nomination.description:
Hush turns iPhone Duo into a treasure chest, and the chest is a sleeping mimic. Stand the Duo like a little laptop: the raised half is the lid. Open it slowly and candlelight spills in to show the gold; drag the loot into your bag gently, then ease the lid shut to bank it. Too fast, and the lid creaks, the mimic wakes and it bites.

It is the first game we know of that scores how slowly you move the hinge. The game reads how fast you move the lid, and the creak in your speaker and your fingers follows it exactly, so being gentle is the whole challenge, and the losing move is the one that's hard on a hinge.

Push-your-luck runs of about two minutes against a burning torch, chests that get richer from Wooden to Royal, four kinds of mimic, a Daily Dungeon with the same chests for everyone, a 24-relic Codex, 12 thief ranks and Game Center. Every other iPhone plays with an on-screen lid slider. No ads, no in-app purchases, no data collected.
nomination.notes: Optimized for iPhone Duo: built for tabletop pose on the inner display. iOS blurs one half of the screen when a fold starts, so Hush draws the chest turned round: the blurring half is the lid, and the loot, meters and warnings stay on the sharp half (Settings: Turn the chest round). Uses the public iOS 27.1 hinge API; never asks for flat, closed or fast. A First Chest lesson teaches by doing. All sound synthesized in the app. Also from us: Squish, Brim and Swoop.
